title: P-Sign
tagline: Enables multiple parties to electronically sign documents without an intermediary.
description:
The project enables users to participate in electronic signatures in a secure, anonymous way using Meta Mask without needing a central authority. The P-Sign service uses Orbit DB to store the metadata, IPFS to store the documents and Ethereum Block Chain to hold the transaction data. 

PSign Service obseletes the need for central authority like DocuSign to make the service happen.
